# Microloop

Microloop turns repeated agent decisions into verified fast paths.

The Python SDK exposes Microloop, DecisionSite, DecisionResult, FallbackResult,
Outcome, PromotionRequirements, decision, and record_outcome. Existing v0.3 imports
remain for compatibility. New integrations should use the decision API.

Read README.md, docs/integration.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/cli.md,
docs/concepts.md, docs/compatibility.md, docs/validation-v0.4.md,
docs/implementation-status-v0.4.md, docs/laya-path.md, and examples/refund_agent/README.md.

Local-first, explicit sites, conservative exact-state coverage, independent outcome
verification, randomized fallback comparison, and explicit maintenance. No cloud,
dashboard, workflow mining, or automatic framework attachment in v0.4.
